name: MovieFIB
description: MovieFIB is a fill-in-the-blank question-answering dataset based on descriptive video annotations for the visually impaired, designed to benchmark video understanding models. It evaluates models' ability to comprehend video content by predicting missing words in video descriptions.
reputation: A known but relatively specialized video fill-in-the-blank benchmark used in video understanding research, with limited mainstream leaderboard presence compared with larger video QA datasets.
notes: Includes analysis of language, 2D and 3D visual features; human evaluation correlates with accuracy.
